preconditions.description: Attacker must be the contract owner (or gain owner privileges)

exploit_hint: As the contract owner, call the blacklistAddress() function with any target contract address and set value to true. This will prevent the target contract from making any transfers (buying/selling tokens) by causing the _transfer() function to revert with 'Blacklisted address' error. The exploit demonstrates abusive owner privilege to arbitrarily block contracts from transacting.
